research_patch.scope: Research-only ordered edge/hinge maps. Changes derived element/accumulation order; no physical equivalence, broad determinism or backend adoption acceptance.
research_patch.scope_of_executable_digest: Recorded CI executable digest; executable bytes are not retained or independently rebuilt by replay.

requested_execution_settings.scope: Requested inherited environment, not a measurement of actual native worker counts.

metrics.scope: Saved-frame vertex/edge/seam diagnostics only; no continuous-time collision, settling, physical-material or fit acceptance.

cloth_body_surface.scope: Complete threshold cloth/body triangle-pair query including vertex-face, edge-edge and intersections; not cloth self-contact, inside/outside or trajectory acceptance.

collar_shirt_surface.scope: Complete threshold cloth/body triangle-pair query including vertex-face, edge-edge and intersections; not cloth self-contact, inside/outside or trajectory acceptance.

construction.scope: One saved frame; nearest-rank unweighted edge percentiles. Shared edges appear in all incident parts. No strain tolerance, seam-quality, settling, continuous-contact, calibrated material or physical-fit acceptance.

principal_strain.scope: Saved-face principal engineering strains are singular-value stretches minus one; absolute strain includes compression. Percentiles weight original rest area, not face count. No stress, physical tolerance, inversion, settling, contact, mesh convergence or fit acceptance.
